compact_space_recovered:
    type: memory_distribution
    memory_unit: byte
    description: >
      Number of bytes recovered by compaction.
    bugs:
      - https://bugzilla.mozilla.org/show_bug.cgi?id=1926152
      - https://bugzilla.mozilla.org/show_bug.cgi?id=1940674
    data_reviews:
      - https://bugzilla.mozilla.org/show_bug.cgi?id=1926152#c7
    notification_emails:
      - telemetry-client-dev@thunderbird.net
    expires: never

Assert.equal(
    Glean.mail.compactSpaceRecovered.testGetValue().sum,
    expungedBytes + fromLineLength,
    "bytes saved should be recorded in Glean"

source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: Current compact_space_recovered accumulates oldSize - newSize only for a successful final status. It is a memory_distribution with memory_unit: byte; the initial compact_bytes_recovered custom_distribution is historical. The test expects expungedBytes plus removed separator overhead, rather than equating the metric with expungedBytes alone. Those tests cover local mbox storage and explicitly leave IMAP offline and maildir coverage as TODOs. Static inspection supports this component scope. No runtime test was run for this lesson, and full Bugzilla and Phabricator discussion is still pending.
title: Measure recovered compaction space from the actual file-size delta
